captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric coin cell battery holder designed to hold multiple batteries upright in a row. It features a rectangular tray base with parallel, arched vertical dividers that partition the holder into individual slots. Each divider has a large circular cutout in its center, which reduces printing material and allows users to push batteries out easily. Two thin side walls run along the length of the tray to secure the batteries laterally.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric coin cell battery holder in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to configure the number of slots, choose between standard battery profiles like CR2032 and AG13, or input custom battery dimensions (radius and width).
captions.factory: The design uses a 'divider' module and a 'holder' module. The 'divider' module is constructed using a 2D-like profile rotated into the vertical plane, consisting of a cylinder with a concentric inner cylinder subtracted from it (difference) to create a hollowed arch, joined with a rectangular cube at the base. The main 'holder' module uses a for-loop to replicate this divider at regular intervals (sizedivider + width) along the length, combined with three long rectangular cubes representing the bottom floor and the two side walls. Conditional 'if' statements at the end instantiate the holder with dimensions corresponding to CR2032, AG13, or custom parameters.
